title: The Elon Method: how Elon Musk went all in to swing the election
summary: Shaan retells 22 events that pushed Elon into backing Trump and extracts his operating pattern: find the existential problem, pick the key lever, burn the boats. Also covers risk as game theory, +EV bets with outsized upside, and separating credibility from likeability.

principles.text: Attack the biggest existential problem, find the key lever, then commit everything to it.
principles.quote: 1. Figure out what is the most Existential Problem 2. Identify the key lever (eg. PA swing state) 3. Go all in. Burn all boats. Throw your entire weight at it
